title: Satisfaction Return and Cancellation Schedule — Northgate Optical
content:
Northgate Optical's satisfaction return window, the treatment of the frame on a return, the refund of a job cancelled before it reaches the lab, and each design's in-lab retained percentage, by lens design:

| Lens design | Satisfaction return window (calendar days after dispensing) | Return refunds the frame as well as the lenses | Cancelled before lab submission: full refund | In-lab retained percentage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Single Vision Lenses | 90 | yes | yes | 50 percent |
| Northgate Lined Bifocal Lenses | 90 | yes | yes | 50 percent |
| Northgate Lined Trifocal Lenses | 90 | yes | yes | 50 percent |
| Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses | 90 | yes | yes | 50 percent |
| Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses | 90 | yes | yes | 50 percent |
| Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses | 90 | yes | yes | 100 percent |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The satisfaction return window is 90 calendar days after dispensing on every design.
2. On every design a satisfaction return refunds the frame as well as the lenses.
3. On every design a job cancelled before it is submitted to the lab is refunded in full.
4. The in-lab retained percentage is a share of the lens charges, tied to cancellation while the job is in the lab: 50 percent on five designs and 100 percent on Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses.

Only the last column differs between designs.
